findings.location: html, aya ya 3: kutofautisha shot na vaccine
findings.source_quote: I don’t call the Covid shot a ‘vaccine’. Not that it doesn’t technically fit the official definition
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha sentensi hizi kuwa: “Jambo moja mtakaloliona katika maandishi haya ni kwamba siiti sindano ya Covid ‘chanjo’. Si kwamba haikidhi kitaalamu ufafanuzi rasmi, bali haifanyi kazi jinsi tulivyozoea chanjo kufanya kazi.”
findings.translation_quote: sitoi chanjo ya Covid kama ‘vaccine’. Si kwamba kihalisia haifai kwa ufasiri wa kifani

findings.location: html, aya ya 3: kumbukumbu ya chanjo ya ndui
findings.source_quote: received a vaccination in my upper arm for smallpox. (The pock mark is still there) ... smallpox, polio, measles
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “ndui” badala ya “korokoto” katika sehemu zote mbili, na badilisha mabano kuwa “(Kovu la chanjo bado lipo)”.
findings.translation_quote: nilipatiwa chanjo juu ya mkono wangu wa juu kwa ugonjwa wa korokoto. (Alama ya mchungu bado ipo) ... korokoto, polio, surua

findings.location: html, aya ya 3: chanjo ya polio
findings.source_quote: the sugar cube treatment which was an oral vaccination against polio
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha “matibabu ya keki ya sukari” kuwa “kupokea kipande cha sukari chenye chanjo ya polio ya kunywa”.
findings.translation_quote: matibabu ya keki ya sukari ambayo ilikuwa chanjo ya mdomo dhidi ya polio

findings.location: html, aya ya 3: mwisho wa vita
findings.source_quote: and the fight was over
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha kuwa “na mapambano yalikuwa yamekwisha”.
findings.translation_quote: na vita vilikuwa vimeshindikana

findings.location: html, aya ya 4: janga duniani
findings.source_quote: this pestilence that had settled on the world
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha kuwa “janga hili lililoikumba dunia”.
findings.translation_quote: taabu hii iliyoweka chawa duniani

findings.location: html, aya ya 4: dai kuhusu kinga
findings.source_quote: this shot does not give an immunization for Covid 19
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha kuwa “sindano hii haitoi kinga dhidi ya Covid-19”; ondoa dai lililoongezwa la “kudumu”.
findings.translation_quote: chanjo hii haiwapi kinga ya kudumu kwa Covid-19

findings.location: html, aya ya 7: kupunguza dalili badala ya kutoa kinga
findings.source_quote: since the shot admittedly mostly reduces symptoms instead of producing immunity
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha kuwa “kwa kuwa inakubaliwa kwamba sindano hii hasa hupunguza dalili badala ya kutoa kinga”.
findings.translation_quote: tangu chanjo hii kwa wazi inapunguza dalili zaidi kuliko kutoa kinga

findings.location: html, aya ya 8: kasi ya kuingia sokoni na madhara
findings.source_quote: The rapid speed with which this shot came on the market ... what all it will bring down the road nor the side effects it may cause
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha sentensi mbili za kwanza kuwa “Kasi kubwa ambayo sindano hii iliingia nayo sokoni ni jambo jingine linalonitia wasiwasi. Kwa kweli hatujui yote itakayoyaleta baadaye wala madhara inayoweza kusababisha.”
findings.translation_quote: Uwezo wa haraka ambao chanjo hii ulifikia sokoni ... nini yote kitakulia mwishoni wala madhara yake ya muda mrefu yanaweza kuleta nini

findings.location: html, aya ya 8: ulinganisho wa kinga
findings.source_quote: an immunity that is far superior to the protection of the shot
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha kuwa “kinga iliyo bora zaidi sana kuliko ulinzi unaotolewa na sindano hiyo”.
findings.translation_quote: kinga iliyokomaa zaidi kuliko ulinzi wa chanjo

findings.location: html, aya ya 10: imani ya mwandishi na kukabidhi maisha kwa Mungu
findings.source_quote: My belief is ... constantly commit our lives to God and look at the whole picture of life and its preservation
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha “Mwamini wangu” kuwa “Imani yangu”, na sehemu ya mwisho kuwa “tunapaswa daima kuyakabidhi maisha yetu kwa Mungu na kutazama maisha na uhifadhi wake kwa ujumla kupitia mtazamo wa maadili ya Kikristo”.
findings.translation_quote: Mwamini wangu ... kila wakati kumtegemea Mungu maisha yetu na kuangalia taswira ya jumla ya uhifadhi wa maisha

findings.location: html, aya ya 11: athari ya mitandao ya kijamii
findings.source_quote: there would not have been near the panic and turmoil
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha kuwa “kusingekuwa na hofu na vurugu zinazokaribia kiwango hicho”.
findings.translation_quote: singekuwa na hofu na vurugu kwa kiwango hicho

findings.location: html, aya ya 11: nukuu ya Ufunuo 13:16-17
findings.source_quote: And he causeth all ... to receive a mark ... And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha nukuu kuwa “Naye anawafanya wote, wadogo na wakubwa, matajiri na maskini, walio huru na watumwa, wapokee alama katika mkono wao wa kuume au katika vipaji vya nyuso zao: Na kwamba mtu yeyote asiweze kununua wala kuuza isipokuwa yule mwenye alama, au jina la mnyama, au hesabu ya jina lake –Ufunuo 13:16-17.”.
findings.translation_quote: Na yeye akamfanya aliyeweza, afanye wote ... na wala hakuna aliyekuwa akiweza kununua au kuuza

findings.location: html, aya ya 12: kudhihakiwa na alama ya mnyama; aya ya 13: alama ya mnyama
findings.source_quote: I have been almost ridiculed for even mentioning the mark of the beast ... I don’t think this is the ‘mark of the beast’
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha mwanzo wa aya ya 12 kuwa “Nimekaribia kudhihakiwa kwa kutaja tu alama ya mnyama.” Katika aya ya 13 tumia “sidhani kwamba hii ndiyo ‘alama ya mnyama’”.
findings.translation_quote: Nimekaribiwa kwa mcheshi kwa hata kutaja alama ya mwitu ... sikufikiria hili ni ‘alama ya mwitu’

findings.location: html, aya ya 12: bibi-arusi na kunyakuliwa
findings.source_quote: Still others think the bride will be raptured before this
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha kuwa “Wengine wanafikiri kwamba bibi-arusi atanyakuliwa kabla ya hili”.
findings.translation_quote: Wengine wengine wanafikiri abiria wa ukoo watatorokewa kabla ya hili kutokea

findings.location: html, aya ya 13: kunyakuliwa na dhiki kuu
findings.source_quote: all believers will be raptured ... escaping what the Bible refers to as ‘great tribulation’
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha kuwa “waamini wote watanyakuliwa kabla ya matukio ya nyakati za mwisho kuanza kutokea, na hivyo kuepuka kile Biblia inachokiita ‘dhiki kuu’”. Hifadhi marejeo na lebo zilizopo.
findings.translation_quote: wote waamini watang'olewa ... kukwepa kile Biblia inaelezea kama ‘taababu kubwa’

findings.location: html, aya ya 14: nukuu ya 2 Wakorintho 6:17
findings.source_quote: come out from among them, and be ye separate ... and touch not the unclean thing
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha nukuu kuwa “Kwa hiyo tokeni kati yao, mkajitenge, asema Bwana, wala msiguse kitu kilicho najisi; nami nitawapokea –2 Wakorintho 6:17.”.
findings.translation_quote: toka miongoni mwao, na jitenge ... mimi sitagusa kitu kisicho safi

findings.location: html, aya ya 14: maelezo ya Ufunuo 14:10-11
findings.source_quote: Revelation 14:10-11 declares that all who take the mark will seal their destiny in hell.
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha sentensi hiyo nzima, pamoja na rejeo lililorudiwa, kuwa “Ufunuo 14:10-11 unasema kwamba wote wanaopokea alama watajifungia hatima yao katika jehanamu.”
findings.translation_quote: Ufunuo 14:10-11 unasema kwamba atakayemwabudu mnyama na picha yake ... katika uwepo wa mungu; hiyo ndiyo Imani ya jinsi ya milele. —Ufunuo 14:10-11.

findings.location: html, aya ya 16: jamii inayomwacha Muumba
findings.source_quote: a society that is bent on going away from the Creator
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha kuwa “jamii iliyodhamiria kuondoka kwa Muumba”.
findings.translation_quote: jamii inayokuwa imeelekea kuto muelekeo wa Muumba

findings.location: html, aya ya 17: sitiari ya kuchanjwa kwa Roho Mtakatifu
findings.source_quote: I’m content to feel safe ... to be inoculated with the Holy Ghost from heaven
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha “nina ujivu kuwa salama” kuwa “ninaridhika kujihisi salama”, na “kuingizwa na Roho Mtakatifu kutoka mbinguni” kuwa “kuchanjwa kwa Roho Mtakatifu kutoka mbinguni” ili kuhifadhi sitiari ya chanzo.
findings.translation_quote: nina ujivu kuwa salama ... kuingizwa na Roho Mtakatifu kutoka mbinguni

findings.location: html, aya za 1–3: sarufi na uwazi
findings.source_quote: has not, received it ... I am quite okay with someone disagreeing ... One of the things ... I don’t remember
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “hajaipata”, “sina tatizo mtu akitofautiana nami”, “Jambo moja”, na “Sikumbuki” katika sehemu husika.
findings.translation_quote: hajaiipata ... sina tatizo mtu akikubali kuwa hapana ... Mmoja wa mambo ... Si nakumbuka

findings.location: html, aya ya 5: unyunyizaji wa dawa
findings.source_quote: spray glyphosate ... every weed ... without missing one
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “kunyunyizia glyphosate”, “kila gugu”, na “bila kuacha hata moja” badala ya maneno yaliyonukuliwa.
findings.translation_quote: kupaka glyphosate ... kila magugu ... bila kupoteza hata moja

findings.location: html, aya za 8–10: upatanisho na maneno
findings.source_quote: our body would build immunity ... a new virus ... If you are overweight ... I don’t belittle this fact
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “mwili wetu ungejenga kinga”, “virusi vipya”, “Ikiwa una uzito uliozidi kiwango kinachofaa”, na “Siudharau ukweli huu” katika sehemu husika; rekebisha pia “virusi hii” kuwa “virusi hivi”.
findings.translation_quote: mwili wetu ujenzia kinga ... virusi mpya ... Ikiwa wewe ni mwenye uzito ... Siharau ukweli huu ... virusi hii

findings.location: html, aya za 11, 13, 16 na 17: misemo isiyo ya kawaida
findings.source_quote: being ‘conditioned’ ... it makes good sense, it defies science not to ... evaluate our attachment ... Will you join me
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “tunavyozoeshwa”, “ina mantiki, na kutofanya hivyo ni kwenda kinyume na sayansi”, “kutathmini kile ambacho tumeshikamana nacho”, na “Je, utaungana nami” katika sehemu husika.
findings.translation_quote: tunavyokuwa ‘‘walivyofunzwa’’ ... inaonekana kufanya akili, kupinga sayansi kutofanya hivyo ... kutathmini uunganisho wetu ... Je, utanijiunga nami
